plain_statement: It is false that: A circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on 9 inputs with at most 15 gates whose first gate computes NOT x_4 and whose function depends on x_4. Then either its function with x_4 false has a circuit of at most 12 gates, or there are circuits A on the other eight inputs and B on A's wires plus one extra wire, with at most 13 gates together, such that B computes the x_4-false function when the extra wire carries a chosen wire of A, and the x_4-true function when it carries a chosen constant.
